what_it_does: Improves instruction prefetching in modern processors by recovering information about branch instructions (decision points in code) that have been evicted from the processor's branch tracking buffer. When the processor loses track of branches, it either fetches the wrong instructions or stops prefetching, which stalls execution and pollutes the instruction cache. Skia stores lightweight 'shadow branch' metadata that allows the prefetch engine to continue speculating on correct execution paths even when branch information has been discarded, reducing stalls in applications with large code footprints.
